concept: Ontology-Constrained Information Extraction and Triplet Mining
summary: Extracting schema-conformant knowledge triples using constrained decoding, ontology schema constraints, and automated SHACL validation.

related.concept: Bitemporal Knowledge Graphs and Entity Resolution
Graph-Structured Agent Episodic and Semantic Memory Architecture
Graph-Guided Hallucination Mitigation and Factual Consistency Verification

facts.text: Closed-schema ontology-constrained extraction binds LLM-generated triples to predefined entity types and relation taxonomies, reducing relational hallucination rates compared to unconstrained OpenIE.
Constrained decoding (grammar-guided token sampling via CFG or JSON Schema) guarantees syntactic validity of extracted graph triples at zero post-processing rejection cost.
Automated SHACL validation against extracted RDF/property graphs detects missing mandatory properties, type mismatches, and orphan relationships before persistence into canonical memory stores.
